enchantments.tooltip: Negative Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming negative energy healing by +27 (Insight bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Profane Well Rounded +2: +2 Profane bonus to all abilities.
Intelligence +13: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +13 Enhancement bonus to Intelligence.

Greater Boon of Undeath: Undead take solace in the hate of others. Every time a character wearing a Boon of Undeath item is struck in combat, an Inflict Moderate Wounds spell will be cast on the character.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
